sources.title: Physics-informed neural networks in groundwater flow modeling ...
sources.snippet: More recently, a new type of physics-informed neural network (PINN) model has been developed to address several limitations by integrating governing physics (groundwater flow equations) into the AI tools. This study presents the systematic advantages of the PINN algorithm for solving groundwater problems using a set of classic test problems.
